fields.Name: Collaboration Space Subtree
fields.Description: Returns all space IDs in the subtree reachable by the acting user, starting from PrimaryScopeRecordID.
fields.SQL:
WITH AncestorCheck AS (
    SELECT s.ID, s.ParentID, s.AgentRetrieval, 0 AS Steps
    FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[Space] s
    WHERE s.ID = TRY_CAST({{ PrimaryScopeRecordID | sqlString }} AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)
      AND LEN(TRIM({{ PrimaryScopeRecordID | sqlString }})) = 36

    UNION ALL

    SELECT a.ID, a.ParentID, a.AgentRetrieval, ac.Steps + 1
    FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[Space] a
    INNER JOIN AncestorCheck ac ON a.ID = ac.ParentID
    WHERE ac.Steps < 32
),
Subtree AS (
    SELECT s.ID AS SpaceID, 0 AS Steps
    FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[Space] s
    INNER JOIN [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[SpaceType] st ON st.ID = s.SpaceTypeID
    WHERE s.ID = TRY_CAST({{ PrimaryScopeRecordID | sqlString }} AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)
      AND LEN(TRIM({{ PrimaryScopeRecordID | sqlString }})) = 36
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM AncestorCheck WHERE AgentRetrieval = 'ExcludedEntirely')
      AND (
          s.ClosedAt IS NULL
          OR (
              COALESCE(s.PostCloseAccess, st.PostCloseAccess, N'None') = N'ReadOnlyWithAgent'
              AND (
                  COALESCE(s.PostCloseAccessDays, st.PostCloseAccessDays) IS NULL
                  OR DATEDIFF(day, s.ClosedAt, GETUTCDATE()) <= COALESCE(s.PostCloseAccessDays, st.PostCloseAccessDays)
              )
          )
      )

    UNION ALL

    SELECT c.ID AS SpaceID, p.Steps + 1
    FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[Space] c
    INNER JOIN [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[SpaceType] cst ON cst.ID = c.SpaceTypeID
    INNER JOIN Subtree p ON c.ParentID = p.SpaceID
    WHERE c.AgentRetrieval NOT IN ('ExcludedEntirely', 'ExcludedFromParentScope')
      AND p.Steps < 32
      AND (
          c.ClosedAt IS NULL
          OR (
              COALESCE(c.PostCloseAccess, cst.PostCloseAccess, N'None') = N'ReadOnlyWithAgent'
              AND (
                  COALESCE(c.PostCloseAccessDays, cst.PostCloseAccessDays) IS NULL
                  OR DATEDIFF(day, c.ClosedAt, GETUTCDATE()) <= COALESCE(c.PostCloseAccessDays, cst.PostCloseAccessDays)
              )
          )
      )
)
SELECT CONVERT(NVARCHAR(36), s.SpaceID) AS SpaceID
FROM Subtree s
INNER JOIN [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationAccess]({{ UserID | sqlString }}) a ON a.SpaceID = s.SpaceID
